description: This Java class defines a SawOscillator, a type of synthesizer unit that generates a sawtooth waveform. It includes methods for setting pitch, frequency, amplitude, and frequency scaling, as well as rendering the waveform based on the current state.

classes.name: SawOscillator
classes.description: A class representing a sawtooth wave oscillator used in sound synthesis, extending the SynthUnit base class.

methods.name: setPitch
methods.description: Converts a pitch value to frequency and sets it.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the oscillator's frequency and updates the phase increment accordingly.

methods.name: updatePhaseIncrement
methods.description: Recalculates the phase increment based on current frequency and scaler.

methods.name: setAmplitude
methods.description: Sets the amplitude of the waveform.

methods.name: setFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Sets the frequency scaler and updates phase increment.

methods.name: incrementWrapPhase
methods.description: Increments phase and wraps it around to stay within [-1, 1].

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the current sample value of the waveform based on phase and amplitude.
